name: Oregon CS300
blurb: Cordless saw. Oregon's manual: 3/8″ low profile (91), .050″ gauge, 52 drive links on the 14″ bar and 56 on the 16″ bar.
intro: The CS300 is Oregon's cordless saw. The operator manual's replacement-component table lists two cutting attachments and states the drive-link count on each: 14″ bar 140SDEA041 with a 52-drive-link PowerSharp chain, part 560507, and 16″ bar 160SDEA041 with a 56-drive-link PowerSharp chain, part 560510. Specifications in the same manual: chain pitch 3/8″ low profile (91), chain gauge .050″, maximum bar length 16″, 6-tooth sprocket. The manual does not print a round-file diameter. Sharpening is the PowerSharp system, and the chain rows include the sharpening stone.

bars.note: Manual replacement table: 14 inch (35 cm) bar 140SDEA041; 14 inch, 52 drive link, saw chain and stone 560507. Pitch 3/8″ low profile (91), gauge .050″.

Manual replacement table: 16 inch (40 cm) bar 160SDEA041; 16 inch, 56 drive link, saw chain and stone 560510. Pitch 3/8″ low profile (91), gauge .050″. Maximum bar length in the specifications is 16″.

sources.title: CS300 operator manual, specifications and replacement components (14″/52 drive links part 560507; 16″/56 drive links part 560510; 3/8″ low profile, .050″)
